task.speaker: client
task.text:
Hi Kenji,

Could you please show 2–3 kerning variations using this exact geometry, bringing the letterforms progressively and only slightly closer together? I’d like to compare them side by side before choosing the final spacing, while retaining the elegant, luxurious character we’ve established.

The spacing is the area I’d like to refine because I currently perceive the word as three visual groups—VEI | LL | VÉ—rather than as one continuous word. A more cohesive rhythm may help resolve that.

For the current direction, Option 2 with the Satin Reflection finish in the bottom right is my favorite—beautiful work. I really like the satin treatment’s warmth and subtle depth, and distributing champagne gold across the Hero V right arm, second V right arm, and É accent creates the strongest visual hierarchy. Even with that preference, I’d like us to continue refining the composition before we finalize the material treatment.

Thank you!
